CustomField.description: Bundle SKU margin percent: (Sum of Bundle Revenue across the bundle group - Sum of Total Per User Per SKU across the bundle group) / Sum of Bundle Revenue across the bundle group. Set via Apex (QuoteMarginRollupPostHook.applyBundleMarginPercent) — the same value is written to every line item (parent + children) in a bundle group, grouped by ParentQuoteLineItemId. Left blank on non-bundle line items.
CustomField.label: Bundle Margin Percent
